title: Sites and docks
description: Sites hold halls, halls hold docks. Carriers book pools or single docks, never a pooled dock directly.
form_description: The time zone sets the site's clock for slots, hours and closures. The region sets its public holidays.

empty.description: Create your first site, then add its halls and docks.

fields.name: Name
fields.subdivision_hint: Sets the regional public holidays. Without a region only the national ones apply.

docks.moves_on_save: Saving moves this dock to the pool for its new profile.
